cases.currentInitialState: Mandatory-reversion counterexample. Root creature is Medium but is legally Tiny under current Polymorph when Banishment establishes at t0. Tiny origin footprint is one 2.5-ft subcell inside a narrow stone alcove whose opening/adjacent region cannot fit Medium anatomy. Polymorph is maintained by a different caster and has an absolute expiry at t20. Banishment cell begins 15x15 horizontally after Tiny+clearance rounding.
actionsAndResolution: At t20 Polymorph expires. The mandatory ending occurs even though the original origin alcove could not fit Medium anatomy; Banishment may not veto or delay it.
Inside the Banishment cell the root Medium 5x5 body is now current. It fits the existing 15x15 cell; if a mandatory result ever exceeded current bounds, BAN-CELL-03 would expand after the event.
At t60 Banishment ends and assigns the current Medium identity to the origin plane at the fixed Tiny-era anchor.
Canonical normal-space placement fails; legal squeeze fails; no nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region fits. Record origin-plane placementConflict=true and destroy the cell.
All HP, conditions and clocks continue. Removing/opening the obstruction later permits canonical placement from the same anchor; Banishment does not resume.
cases.currentAdjudication: The accepted mandatory body rule is preserved exactly in substance: Polymorph ends on its own deadline regardless of origin fit. The later Banishment ending creates no terrain ward and no extraplanar hold; unresolved fit is the canonical origin-plane placement conflict.
